headline: Cencosud Posts $23 Million Profit in Third Quarter
summary: Cencosud reported a net profit of $23 million for the third quarter, rebounding from a loss of $16 million in the same period last year. However, profits for the first nine months fell 65% due to a weak first half of 2026.
why: Cencosud is a major Latin American retail conglomerate operating supermarkets and department stores across several countries.
